author: Gould, 1838
summary: 낙엽수림이나 낙엽송 숲, 혼효림에 살며 보통 혼자 지내는 새이다. 다른 새의 둥지에 알을 낳아 그 새가 품어 깨우게 하는 탁란 습성이 있다. 곤충을 주로 먹고 울음소리가 독특하다. 우리나라를 비롯해 아무르, 우수리, 만주, 인도차이나, 말레이반도, 인도 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Indian Cuckoo (Cuculus micropterus), adult male as seen in Korean woods from May to August: head and neck dark grey; back, rump and wings grey-brown, browner than the head; lores, chin, throat and upper breast grey; lower breast and belly white crossed by broad, widely spaced black bars; vent and undertail coverts white; tail grey-brown with a broad black subterminal band and a white tip. Bill dark with a yellowish base; dark brown iris with a yellow eye-ring; legs yellow.
art.pose: perched alone on a branch, calling
art.scene: Korean deciduous woodland with larch stands and mixed forest; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: dark grey head and neck, browner grey-brown back, grey throat and upper breast, white belly with broad, widely spaced black bars, dark eye with a yellow eye-ring, yellow legs
adult male, tail seen from below: graduated grey-brown tail with a broad black subterminal band and a white tip, white undertail coverts
art.build: Medium-sized, slim, long-tailed cuckoo, about the size of a Common Cuckoo, with long, pointed, falcon-like wings and a long, graduated tail; perches rather horizontally with the wings drooped below the tail base. Bill short and slightly decurved. Legs short, yellow, with two toes forward and two back. The long tail extends well beyond the wingtips at rest. Flight fast and direct, hawk-like.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow iris; Indian Cuckoo has a dark eye with a yellow eye-ring (Common and Oriental Cuckoos have yellow eyes).
Do not paint narrow, dense barring on the underparts; the black bars are broad and widely spaced.
Do not omit the broad black subterminal tail band; Common Cuckoo lacks it.
Do not paint the back the same blue-grey as the head; it is browner.
